title: Ext adjunction for exact adjoints
statement: Let C and D be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], with Ext groups [def-pc-ext], and assume D has enough injectives [def-sp-enough-injectives]. Let L : C to D and R : D to C be additive exact functors with an adjunction L left adjoint to R. For every A in C, G in D, and n >= 0, pushing Ext classes forward by L and postcomposing with the counit induces an additive equivalence Ext_C^n(A,R(G)) to Ext_D^n(L(A),G).

source.place: Lemma 06XR, computation of Ext by injective resolutions; the exact adjunction argument used in Cohomology on Sites, Lemma 03F3. Agent specialization to arbitrary exact adjoints.

proof.text: Choose an injective resolution G to I. Since L preserves monomorphisms, its right adjoint R preserves injectives. Exactness of R makes R(G) to R(I) an injective resolution. In every degree the additive Hom adjunction identifies Hom_C(A,R(I)) with Hom_D(L(A),I) and commutes with differentials. Taking cohomology and applying the Ext/injective-resolution comparison gives the additive equivalence. The resulting map is pushforward by L followed by the counit. The existing source declaration proves its bijectivity also by dimension shifting; it needs no enough-injectives assumption on C.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 06XR and the exact adjunction argument of Stacks 03F3; existing source proof by dimension shifting.
